exposure: primary surgeon's training grade (ST2, ST3, ST6+)
cohort: The study included 3099 uncomplicated elective lower segment caesarean sections performed by 60 trainees (ST2, ST3, ST6+) on singleton pregnancies with specific maternal and gestational age criteria.
finding: Training progression of the primary surgeon and the experience level of the surgical assistant were both significantly associated with a reduction in procedure time and estimated blood loss during elective lower segment caesarean sections.
